name: fitos
description: FITOS - a tenant-safe fitness business operating system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=@fitos/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@fitos/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@fitos/worker"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@fitos/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@fitos/shared && npm run build --workspace=@fitos/auth && npm run build --workspace=@fitos/ui && npm run build --workspace=@fitos/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@fitos/api && npm run build --workspace=@fitos/worker && npm run build --workspace=@fitos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fitos/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fitos/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace=@fitos/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
